title: Normalized lifting of prescribed vertex equivalences
statement: Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, Kan complexes, internal functor simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in universes containing all displayed constructions. Let $J$ be a small simplicial set, $J_0^{\mathrm{disc}}=\coprod_{j\in J_0}\Delta^0$, and $D$ a quasicategory. Use equivalence edges and cores as defined in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Write $r:\operatorname{Fun}(J,D)^\simeq\to\operatorname{Fun}(J_0^{\mathrm{disc}},D)^\simeq$ for restriction. For any diagram $d:J\to D$ and any fixed edge $e:\Delta^1\to\operatorname{Fun}(J_0^{\mathrm{disc}},D)^\simeq$ with $e(0)=r(d)$, define $\mathcal L(d,e)_n$ to be the maps $h:\Delta^n\times\Delta^1\to\operatorname{Fun}(J,D)^\simeq$ with $h|_{\Delta^n\times\{0\}}$ the constant map at $d$ and $rh=e\,\operatorname{pr}_2$. Then $\mathcal L(d,e)$ is a nonempty contractible Kan complex. A vertex supplies a diagram $d'$ with exactly the prescribed terminal vertex values and an equivalence $d\to d'$ restricting to $e$. Restriction of all simplicial parameters gives the higher comparisons in this same contractible space. The terminal diagram is allowed to vary; only the initial diagram and the entire vertex-equivalence path are fixed.
